podcast.title: Emmy Award Win for Roseanne
podcast.body: She eventually won an Emmy for her performance on the series Roseanne, where she played Rosanne's sister, Jackie. "But both Barr and Laurie Metcalf, who played Rosanne's sister Jackie, eventually walked away with Emmys for their performance on the series."

xref.title: Emmy Nominations and Wins
xref.body: Despite its sharp comedy and "segment-busting storylines," the series was never nominated for a best comedy series Emmy. However, Barr eventually won an Emmy for her performance on the series. "But both Barr and Laurie Metcalf, who played Rosanne's sister Jackie, eventually walked away with Emmys for their performance on the series."
